dish: local-sourced miso ramen (Hokkaido wheat, pork bone, custom miso)
n: Ramen Sapporo Ichiryūan (ラーメン札幌一粒庵)
address: Hokuren Bldg B1F, Kita 4-jō Nishi 1-chōme, Chuo-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan
w: The station-side ramen shop most fixated on local sourcing — Hokkaido wheat noodles, Hokkaido pork bones and vegetables, miso made to order.

dish: rich miso ramen on pork-bone + chicken paitan
n: Menya Yukikaze Susukino Honten (麺屋 雪風 すすきの本店)
w: No. 3 in MAPPLE's Sapporo ramen top 30 — a rich-yet-clean 'nōkō miso' of pork-bone and chicken paitan with curly medium noodles.

dish: ebi-soba — sweet-shrimp broth (miso, shio or shōyu)
n: Ebisoba Ichigen Sōhonten (えびそば一幻 総本店)
w: Sapporo's prawn-ramen original, burning through ~60 kg of shrimp heads a day; pick your broth from pure shrimp to half pork-bone.

dish: shime parfait — the after-drinks parfait, everything made in-house
n: Parfait, Coffee, Sake, Satō Honten (パフェ、珈琲、酒、佐藤 本店)
address: Kino Ninary Bldg 1F–3F, Minami 1-jō Nishi 2-chōme 1-2, Chuo-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido 060-0061, Japan
w: The flag-bearer of Sapporo's 'shime parfait' — the night-capping parfait — with Hokkaido-milk ice cream, sorbets and bakes all made in-house; open till midnight.

address: F.DRESS Gogai Bldg 2F, Minami 3-jō Nishi 5-chōme 36-1, Chuo-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan
w: A pioneer of the night-parfait boom built on 'dessert and alcohol marriage' — sculptural parfaits till midnight, three minutes from Susukino.
